name: Ozi Image Alt Tag Fixer — Zero-Config SEO Image Optimizer Lite
author: Simmi Ahuja

sections.faq:
**1. Will this overwrite existing alt tags?**

No — unless you turn on the “Override existing alt tags” option.

**2. Does this change filenames or URLs?**

No. Only the alt attribute is updated.

**3. Does this work with Divi, Elementor, Bricks, Gutenberg?**

Yes. It works anywhere images render.

**4. Does this impact performance?**

No. It’s extremely lightweight.

sections.description:
Automatically fixes missing image alt tags using smart rules. Lightweight, fast, and fully automated SEO + accessibility improvement. —

Overview

Most websites have hundreds of images without proper alt tags.
Search engines dislike it. Screen readers struggle with it.
Fixing them manually is time-consuming.

Ozi Image Alt Tag Fixer solves this instantly.

The plugin scans your site, finds missing alt tags, and fills them intelligently using your chosen mode — filename, page title, matched keywords or a hybrid mix.

It works in the Media Library and on the frontend (Divi, Elementor, WooCommerce, any theme).

No settings are required, but an optional settings page lets you choose how alt tags are generated.

Key Features

✓ Automatic ALT Tag Fixing

Automatically adds missing alt tags to all images output on your site.

✓ Bulk Fix Media Library

One click updates all missing alt values using smart logic.

✓ Four Intelligent ALT Modes

  1. Simple Mode — Primary keyword + filename
  2. Smart Mode — Keyword match
  3. Page-Aware Mode — Uses the page title
  4. Hybrid Mode — Best of all modes

✓ Works Everywhere

Frontend, page builders, WooCommerce, blogs — any <img> tag.

✓ Lightweight & Fast

No APIs, no external services, no heavy scripts.

✓ Accessibility Friendly

Improves screen-reader experience and WCAG compliance.

✓ SEO Optimized

Better image search visibility and overall ranking signals.

How It Works

  1. Install the plugin
  2. Visit Ozi Alt Tag Fixer → Dashboard
  3. Click Bulk Fix Missing Alt Tags
  4. All missing alt tags are updated instantly
  5. Optional: Configure alt generation mode in Settings

Use Cases

  • Bloggers with large media libraries
  • WooCommerce stores
  • SEO professionals improving accessibility
  • Agencies managing multiple sites
  • Anyone wanting better SEO without manual work

Upgrade Path: OziDigital PRO

Unlock more SEO tools:
– SEO content analysis
– Meta automation
– Schema markup
– Keyword insights
– AI-assisted optimization
– Full on-page SEO suite

Credits

Created by Ozinexus Technologies, Australia.
